tagline: A brief scenic interval between two freeway junctions.
intro: From SR 94, Route 125 crosses into La Mesa and runs west of Mount Helix to Interstate 8. Caltrans designates this stretch scenic, a memorable landscape without visual intrusions. In 2018 the part between SR 94 and Lemon Avenue also carried 183,000 vehicles a day, more than any other part of the route. La Mesa began discussing the designation in 1968.

Nearby Eucalyptus County Park recalls another transportation scheme. Charles Crosby planted eucalyptus for railroad ties, transplanting some seedlings to a picnic ground that became the heart of the park.

moments.title: SR 94 junction
moments.text: The freeway from here toward old US 80 opened as Route 67 in 1957, before the 1964 renumbering made it Route 125.

moments.title: Interstate 8 junction
moments.text: The original interchange gave no way onto Route 125 from eastbound I-8 and no way onto westbound I-8 from Route 125, so La Mesa asked the state for changes.
